observed_blocker.reason: The material runner calls its constant global refusal before reading and validating the published preread or worker bundle.

required_phases.name: PREPARE_GATE_INTERFACE
required_phases.requirement: Add a fail-closed activation-proof input to the outer run and every independently admitted worker before any scope or source write; keep plan generation BLOCKED_PREPARATION_REVIEW.

required_phases.name: FREEZE_NEW_INTERFACE
required_phases.requirement: Run refusal and tiny controls, then create a fresh plan and complete runtime freeze binding every changed material byte and exact bounded platform.

required_phases.name: PUBLISH_PREPARATION
required_phases.requirement: Publish the new code, protocol, tests, plan and freeze by non-force fast-forward and independently read back their exact parent, tree and blobs.

required_phases.name: PUBLISH_DISTINCT_PREREAD
required_phases.requirement: Create and publish a fresh preread bound to the new public preparation commit, plan, freeze and code pins; independently read it back.

required_phases.name: MARKER_ONLY_ACTIVATION
required_phases.requirement: Make the next science-branch commit a single-parent direct child of the preread commit adding exactly one unique activation marker; the marker binds the independent preread readback and grants only one engineering control.

required_phases.name: ONE_FRESH_CONTROL
required_phases.requirement: After marker readback, run exactly one fresh eight-input engineering control under original cumulative limits; no retry, rerun, resume, RNG, telescope data, native or scientific case.

required_phases.name: FINAL_DISPOSITION
required_phases.requirement: Preserve all output, failures, vetoes and complete resource receipts; pass or fail without tuning.
